spans.s:
परि-√ बन्ध् Ā. -बध्नीते (impf. 3. sg. पर्य्-अबन्धत, MBh.; Pass. पर्य्-अबध्यत, ib.; pf. Ā. परि-बेधिरे॑, AV.),
to tie to, bind on, put on;
to surround, encircle:
Caus. -बन्धयति, to tie round, embrace, span, Cat.
bound, stopped, obstructed, R.
tying round, L.
hindrance or a hinderer, RV.
a noxious or troublesome demon, MantraBr.
trouble, toil, hardship, Śak.
(Desid. of परि- √ 3. भुज्), very hungry, MBh.

परि-√ बृंह् (√ 2. बृंह्, also written वृंह् in verb forms and deriv.) P. Ā. -बृंहति (or -बृहति), ˚ते (p. pf. Ā. -बबृहाण, prob. solid, strong, RV. v, 41, 12), to embrace, encircle, fasten, make big or strong, Br. :
Caus. -बृंहयति, to make strong, strengthen, MBh.
(ifc. f(आ). ) ‘surroundings’, retinue, train, furniture, attire, trim, property, wealth, the necessaries of life, MBh.; R. &c.
royal insignia, L.
पारि—बर्ह m. sg. and pl. = परि-ब्˚, MBh.
N. of a son of Garuḍa, ib.
परि-बर्ह—वत् mfn. (a house) provided with suitable furniture, Ragh.
retinue, train, attire, trim, MBh.
worship, adoration, BhP.
growth, increase, Nir., Sch.
prosperity, welfare, BhP.
an additional work, supplement, Mn.; MBh.
(or ˚वृहित; cf. Pāṇ. vii, 2, 21, Sch.) increased, augmented, strengthened by, connected or furnished with (instr. or comp.), MBh.; BhP.
the roar of an elephant, L.
(प॑रि-), mfn. firm, strong, solid, ŚBr.; Nir.
reason (-वत् mfn. endowed with reason, Śak. v, 21, v.l.)
exhortation, admonition (also f(आ). ), Kād.
to be admonished, ib.
परि-बोध—वत् mfn., endowed with reason, Śak. v, 21, v.l.
परि-√ ब्रू P. -ब्रवीति (Pot. -ब्रूयात्), to utter a spell or charm, lay under a spell, enchant, AV.; Kāṭh.
